name: Size of the Chen Neighbor Puncture
proof: The base has 100 words. The removed word is in the base, and exactly two of its twelve Hamming neighbors are already in the remaining base. The union therefore has $99+12-2=109$ distinct words. The definition-driven verifier checks the count.
references: Definition-driven certificate and independent replay: sync/verify_chen_neighbor_puncture.py; sync/chen_neighbor_puncture_certificate.json.gz. The original Chen base is from \cite{chen2016recursive}; the puncture modification and its separation proof are local results.
